WithEnvironments.note: Three environments with their Cloud badge plus the Setting up / Setup failed status badges, and the dashed add row underneath. Page header + section header both present.

EmptyState.note: SettingsEmptyState full variant with the Folder icon and the secondary add action.

LoadFailed.note: cloudErrorMessage renders the error row with Retry beneath the surviving environment, and the add row is still offered.

CloudUnavailable.note: cloudUnavailableReason takes precedence: the unavailable row replaces the list and correctly suppresses the add affordance.
